meta.name: find-lookalikes
meta.description: Find companies similar to a seed domain via PredictLeads' similar_companies endpoint and persist them as a result set ready for enrichment or qualification. Use when the user says 'find lookalikes for [domain]', 'companies similar to [name]', 'show me lookalike accounts', 'expand from this company', or 'discover similar prospects'. Side-effecting — calls PredictLeads API and writes to local cache.

copy.tagline: 根据已知公司发现相似潜在客户
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在寻找与现有客户相似的新公司作为销售目标。
copy.tagline_en: Discover companies similar to a known domain for prospecting.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to find new companies similar to your existing customers for sales targeting.

howto.what: 安装后，你提供一个公司域名，Claude 会调用 PredictLeads 找到相似公司，保存为结果集，方便后续丰富或筛选。
howto.when: 当你说“查找类似公司”并提供域名，或说“显示类似客户”、“扩展这家公司”等时触发。

howto.what_en: After installation, when you provide a seed domain, Claude calls PredictLeads API to find similar companies and persists them as a result set for enrichment or qualification.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'find lookalikes for [domain]', 'companies similar to [name]', 'show me lookalike accounts', or similar phrases.
